about.faq.title: 常见问题
about.faq.subtitle: 快速了解常用功能。
about.faq.free.a: 自建版的基本播放和下载无需购买在线服务订阅，运行所需的存储、带宽和计算由自己的服务器承担。在线服务的套餐规则请以官网为准。
about.faq.vpn.q: 浏览器会直接连接 BT 网络吗？
about.faq.vpn.a: 浏览器从 Webtor 服务器获取数据，不直接连接 BT 节点。自建时，由你的 NAS 连接 BT 网络；是否加密浏览器连接取决于是否配置 HTTPS。
about.faq.mobile.q: 可以在手机或平板上使用吗？
about.faq.mobile.a: 可以，现代 iOS 和 Android 浏览器均可访问，观看视频、收听音频或下载文件，无需安装 BT 客户端。
about.faq.formats.q: 支持哪些视频和音频格式？
about.faq.formats.a: 视频支持 AVI、MKV、MP4、WEBM、M4V、TS、VOB；音频支持 MP3、WAV、OGG、FLAC、M4A。需要转码的文件可能启动较慢。
about.faq.opensource.a: 是，Webtor 组件以 MIT 许可证发布，可以在 GitHub 查看源码并参与贡献。
about.faq.smarttv.q: 可以在智能电视上观看吗？
about.faq.smarttv.a: 可以，在电视的 Stremio 中安装个人设置页面提供的插件，即可播放媒体库内容。
about.faq.indexers.q: 能连接自己的 Jackett 或 Prowlarr 吗？
about.faq.indexers.a: 可以，在个人设置中添加索引器的 Torznab 来源地址。结果会与 Stremio 插件结果一起显示在发现页面和 Webtor Stremio 插件中。
about.faq.releaseSubs.q: 出现新剧集或资源时能通知我吗？
about.faq.releaseSubs.a: 可以，在发现页面或种子页面订阅电影、正在播出的一季剧集，Webtor 会检查已连接的来源。邮件通知需配置邮件服务。
about.faq.openTorrent.q: 如何在浏览器中打开 .torrent 文件？
about.faq.openTorrent.a: 将 .torrent 文件拖入页面顶部的上传区域即可，也可参阅分步指南。
about.faq.magnetDownload.q: 如何不用 BT 客户端下载磁力资源？
about.faq.magnetDownload.a: 在页面顶部输入磁力链接，服务器会获取种子并提供文件下载直链，也可使用内置播放器边下边播。
about.faq.magnetUse.a: 粘贴到页面顶部的输入框，或拖入 .torrent 文件。Webtor 服务器获取数据，浏览器负责播放或下载。
about.faq.openTorrentApp.a: 可用 Webtor，在 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS 浏览器中打开。
about.faq.unzipTorrent.a: .torrent 文件不是压缩包。用 Webtor 打开后下载其中的实际文件，或使用打包下载工具获取 ZIP。
about.faq.downloadTorrented.q: 如何不用 BT 客户端获取种子里的文件？
about.faq.downloadTorrented.a: 在 Webtor 打开种子，然后点击文件的 HTTP 下载链接即可。
about.faq.aiDiscover.q: 发现页面和 AI 推荐如何工作？
about.faq.aiDiscover.a: 在发现页面输入想看的内容或点击推荐词，即可获取影片及推荐理由，再通过配置的来源选择播放。AI 功能需服务端配置。
about.faq.aiQuota.q: AI 推荐有使用次数限制吗？
about.faq.aiQuota.a: 当前配置为每个普通账号每天 {{.FreeQuota}} 次 AI 请求，支持者每天 {{.PaidQuota}} 次。只有自然语言搜索消耗此配额。
about.faq.aiModel.q: AI 推荐使用什么模型？会发送哪些数据？
about.faq.aiModel.anthropic: 推荐由 Anthropic Claude 生成，发送影片标题、年份和评分历史，不发送邮箱或 IP 地址，结果仅用于影视推荐。
about.faq.aiModel.openai: 推荐由 OpenAI GPT 模型生成，发送影片标题、年份和评分历史，不发送邮箱或 IP 地址，结果仅用于影视推荐。
about.faq.expire.q: 下载或播放链接会过期吗？
about.faq.expire.a: 会，直链和播放会话具有有效期，过期后可刷新页面或在媒体库重新生成。
about.faq.zip.q: 为什么 ZIP 解压时出现 CRC 错误？
about.faq.zip.a: ZIP 实时生成，不含完整校验信息，部分工具会误报 CRC 错误。目录默认使用 TAR；若选择 ZIP，建议使用 7-Zip 解压。
about.faq.speed.q: 为什么下载或播放很慢？
about.faq.speed.a1: 速度受做种者数量、是否需要转码、网络状况及服务器负载等影响。在线服务还可能受套餐带宽限制。
about.faq.streamVsDownload.q: 边下边播和直接下载有什么区别？
about.faq.streamVsDownload.a: 边下边播无需等待完整文件下载，数据缓存在服务器上。需要本地副本时，也可使用普通下载功能保存文件。
about.faq.streamVsDownload.link: 阅读博客中的详细对比
about.faq.speed.a2: 带宽以 Mbps（兆比特/秒）表示，文件大小以 MB（兆字节）表示。1 MB = 8 Mb，因此 50 Mbps 约等于 6.25 MB/s。

tool.torrentToMp4.about.steps.title: How to get a playable video out of a torrent
tool.torrentToMp4.about.steps.subtitle: No converter, no BitTorrent client, no waiting for a full download — three steps and the video plays.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.steps.step1.text: Upload a .torrent file or paste a magnet link into Webtor.io.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.steps.step2.text: Webtor reads the torrent and lists the files it contains — the video is one of them, already in MP4, MKV or AVI.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.steps.step3.text: Press play to watch in the browser, or take the direct link and save the original file as it is.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.explained.title: Why "torrent to MP4" has nothing to convert
tool.torrentToMp4.about.explained.p1: A .torrent file holds no video at all. It is a small index: the names and sizes of the files, their checksums, and where to find the peers that have them. Converting it to MP4 makes as much sense as converting a library catalogue into a book — the thing you want is not in there yet.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.explained.p2: The video arrives when the torrent is actually downloaded, and it arrives in whatever container the release used — usually MP4 or MKV, sometimes AVI. Webtor.io skips the middle step: it fetches the torrent in the cloud, shows you the files inside, and plays the video in the browser while it downloads. Nothing to install, nothing to convert.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.title: What you get instead of a converter
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.subtitl: Desktop converters need the finished file first, which means a BitTorrent client, disk space and a wait. Playing in the cloud removes all three.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.item1: Playback starts in seconds, without the full download
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.item2: MKV, AVI and HEVC play in the browser as they are
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.item3: The original file downloads by direct link, untouched
tool.torrentToMp4.about.benefits.item4: Nothing installed, nothing left on your disk
tool.torrentToMp4.about.devices.title: Works wherever a browser does
tool.torrentToMp4.about.devices.subtitle: The video is transcoded on the server, so the device only has to play ordinary video — which every modern browser can.
tool.torrentToMp4.about.devices.item2: iPhone and iPad, where no torrent client is allowed
tool.torrentToMp4.about.devices.item4: Smart TVs and streaming boxes via Stremio
tool.torrentToMp4.about.safety.title: Is this safer than a desktop converter?
tool.torrentToMp4.about.safety.text: With Webtor.io the torrent is fetched by the server, not by your computer, so your IP address never joins the swarm and you never seed. Nothing is installed, and no half-finished file is left behind on your disk.

tool.openTorrentFile.about.steps.title: How to open a .torrent file in three steps
tool.openTorrentFile.about.steps.subtitl: Nothing to install and nothing to configure — the file opens in the browser tab you already have open.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.steps.step1.t: Upload the .torrent file, or paste a magnet link if that is what you have.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.steps.step2.t: Webtor reads the file and lists its contents — names, sizes and formats, before anything is downloaded.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.steps.step3.t: Press play to watch a video right away, or take the direct link to save a file to your device.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.explained.p1: A .torrent file contains no content at all. It is an index: the names and sizes of the files, checksums to verify them by, and the trackers that know who currently has them. That is why double-clicking it does nothing useful until something can read it.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.explained.p2: The usual answer is to install a BitTorrent client. It works, but it means software on your machine, a download that must finish before you can watch anything, and your own connection sharing the data with strangers.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.explained.p3: Webtor.io reads the file on the server instead. You get the same contents listing in seconds, and playback starts before the download is anywhere near finished — because the video is streamed to you rather than assembled on your disk.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.benefits.titl: Why open it in a browser
tool.openTorrentFile.about.benefits.subt: The browser route removes the three things people actually dislike about opening torrents.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.benefits.item: No client to install, no settings to get right
See the contents before committing to a download
Playback starts in seconds, not after the last byte
Your connection never joins the swarm
tool.openTorrentFile.about.formats.title: Opens what is normally awkward to open
tool.openTorrentFile.about.formats.subti: Whatever the release used, the video plays without a codec pack and every other file downloads as it is.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.formats.item1: MP4, MKV and AVI video, including HEVC
tool.openTorrentFile.about.formats.item2: ZIP and RAR archives, saved as they are
tool.openTorrentFile.about.safety.title: Is opening a torrent file this way safe?
tool.openTorrentFile.about.safety.text: The torrent is fetched by Webtor.io's servers, not by your computer, so your IP address never joins the swarm and you never seed. Nothing is installed, and nothing is left on your disk unless you choose to download it.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.faq.q1.questi: What can I use to open a torrent file?
tool.openTorrentFile.about.faq.q1.answer: A browser is enough: upload the .torrent file to Webtor and its contents are listed, ready to play or download. Desktop torrent clients open it too, but they install software on your machine and join the swarm with your own connection.
tool.openTorrentFile.about.faq.q2.questi: How do I open a .torrent file in my browser?
tool.openTorrentFile.about.faq.q2.answer: Drop the file onto the upload area at the top of this page, or choose it from the file picker. Webtor reads it and lists every file inside — press play on a video or take the download link for any file.

tool.howToDownloadTorrentFiles.about.exp: Why a torrent normally makes this hard

A torrent is not a download link. It is a list of pieces spread across other people's computers, which is why a client has to collect them, verify them and reassemble the file before you have anything you can use.

That is fine when the swarm is healthy and you wanted everything. It is a poor deal when you needed one episode out of forty, or when the client will keep uploading from your connection long after you are done.

Webtor.io does the collecting on the server and hands you an ordinary HTTP link. Your browser downloads it the way it downloads anything else — resumable, one file at a time if you like, and finished when the file is on your disk.

tool.howToDownloadTorrentFiles.about.faq: How do I download torrented files without a torrent client?

Open the torrent in Webtor: upload the .torrent file or paste the magnet link, and the files inside are listed. Pick the one you want and press Download — it is an ordinary HTTPS link, so the browser saves it like any other file.
Can I download just one file from a torrent?

Yes. Every file in the listing has its own download link, so you can take a single file and leave the rest. If you want everything at once, the Torrent to ZIP tool packs the whole torrent into one archive.
Where do the downloaded files go?

Wherever your browser saves downloads: the Downloads folder on a computer, the Files app on an iPhone. Nothing else is left on the machine — there is no client, no cache and no torrent to seed afterwards.
How do I download torrented files on a phone?

The same way: open this page in the phone's browser, add the torrent and tap Download next to the file. The iPhone specifics — where Safari puts the file and how to play it — are on the Watch Torrents on iOS page.
Why is my download slow or stuck at 0%?

A torrent only moves as fast as its seeders: Webtor's servers fetch the content from the swarm first, and a torrent with no active seeders has nowhere to fetch it from. Once the file is on the server it downloads at ordinary web speed, with a speed cap on the free plan.

tool.utorrentWebAlternative.about.explai: What uTorrent Web is — and what Webtor does differently

uTorrent Web (also called uTWeb) is a desktop program for Windows and Mac. Its own page says so: it is software you download, and once installed it opens in a new tab of Chrome, Firefox or Opera. It runs in the system tray, saves downloads to a folder on your computer, seeds them back to other peers, and can play video while the download is still running. BitTorrent Web works the same way and has the same free and paid tiers.

Webtor.io is a web page and nothing else. There is no installer and no process left running on your machine: Webtor's servers join the swarm, fetch the torrent, and hand your browser a video stream or a file over ordinary HTTPS. That is why it works the same on Windows, Mac, Linux, Chromebook, Android and iPhone — there is no version to download for each of them.

A local client is still the better tool for some jobs. uTorrent Web keeps a full copy of every download on your disk, can go on seeding to other peers after the download finishes, and the files stay available offline. If you want to seed, or you download large archives you will keep for years, install a client. If you want to watch a video or grab a file right now, on whatever device is in front of you, open Webtor.

tool.debridAlternative.about.explained.t: What a debrid does — and what Webtor does instead
tool.debridAlternative.about.explained.p: A debrid service keeps cached copies of torrents and serves them over HTTP. Stremio users pair one with the addons that list its links: the file plays from the debrid's servers, so the device never downloads from other peers. The cache belongs to the service — a file that is not in it has to be fetched first, and a cache is not storage: a file stays only as long as the service keeps it.

Webtor.io does the same job for the torrents you bring. Add a magnet link or .torrent file to your library, and the Webtor Stremio addon plays it from Webtor's servers, which join the swarm in place of your device. Webtor is not a debrid: it keeps no catalog of streams and resolves no hoster links — what shows up in Stremio comes from your own torrents, the addons you added and the indexers you connected. Playing through Webtor's servers needs a paid Webtor plan.

The two also combine. Connect your TorBox or Real-Debrid account in the Webtor profile as a streaming backend, and a play first asks that service whether it already has the file; if it does, the file plays through it, with no charge from Webtor. Only what it lacks — or cannot answer for — falls through to Webtor's servers.

tool.torrentRssAlternative.about.explain: What a torrent RSS feed does — and why you may not need one

A torrent RSS feed is the classic way to automate downloads: a client or a tool like Sonarr polls the feed and grabs new releases that match your filters. It works, but it means a client that never sleeps, filter rules to maintain, and usually a home server or NAS.

Webtor's release subscriptions do the same job server-side. Subscribe to a season or a movie once, and Webtor polls your own indexers and Stremio addons for you — everything new arrives as an email with links you can stream right away.
tool.torrentRssAlternative.about.compare: Webtor subscriptions vs a Sonarr / RSS stack
Both watch your trackers for new releases. The difference is who runs the machinery.
Nothing to host — works from your browser
Uses your own indexers and Stremio addons
New releases arrive as one batched email
Stream instantly, no disk space needed
Needs an always-on server or NAS
Client, proxy and filter rules to maintain

If you want a complete self-hosted media pipeline, Sonarr is excellent. If you just want to know when a new episode or a better rip appears — and watch it right away — a one-click subscription does it with none of the upkeep.
tool.torrentRssAlternative.about.benefit: One click on a bell replaces an entire RSS pipeline.
Email alerts for new episodes of airing seasons
New rips of a movie you are waiting for
Subscriptions search only the indexers and addons you connected yourself, on gentle schedules — a private tracker sees less traffic than from a typical RSS poller. Every email names the source that found the release, and unsubscribing is one click away.
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.steps.tit: How to use Stremio addons online with Webtor.io
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.steps.sub: Connect your Stremio addons and watch torrents online in 3 simple steps — right in your browser, no Stremio app required.
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.steps.ste: Sign in to Webtor.io and open the Discover page — movie and series catalogs from Cinemeta are already there.
Use the built-in addon wizard to add official and community Stremio addons in a couple of clicks, or paste any addon manifest URL.
Pick a title and press play
Webtor collects torrent streams from your addons and plays them online in your browser — no downloads, no torrent client.
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.explained: What are Stremio addons and how do they work online?

Stremio addons are small web services that provide catalogs, metadata and stream sources — including torrent streams — for the Stremio media center. Normally they require the Stremio app installed on your device.

Webtor.io speaks the same addon protocol, so the addons you already use in Stremio work online too: Webtor queries them for torrent sources and plays the result in its cloud player with real-time HLS transcoding — any format, any browser.
Why use Stremio addons in the browser?
The Stremio app has to be installed, and on many devices its torrent streaming is limited or unavailable. Webtor turns any browser into a Stremio-compatible player.
No Stremio installation — everything works online
All your addon catalogs and torrent sources in one place
Torrents play in the cloud — your device never joins the swarm
Works even where the Stremio app can’t stream torrents, like iPhone and iPad
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.safety.ti: Is it safe to use Stremio addons online?
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.safety.te: Yes. You choose which addons to connect, and Webtor.io talks to them server-side. Torrent data is fetched by Webtor’s cloud and delivered to your browser over encrypted HTTPS — no VPN needed, no ports to open, and no peer-to-peer traffic touches your network.
tool.stremioAddonsOnline.about.devices.s: Anything with a modern browser becomes a Stremio-compatible streaming player — and with the personal Webtor addon the integration also works the other way around, inside Stremio itself.

tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.steps.subt: Three steps, nothing to install — the heavy lifting happens on Webtor's servers, not on your device.
tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.steps.step: Drop the file or link on the home page. The cloud client picks it up and connects to the BitTorrent swarm within seconds.
Peers, trackers and uploads stay on our side. No client to configure, no port forwarding, and nothing torrent-related runs on your device.
Play video right in the browser while the torrent downloads, or save any file through a plain HTTPS link — like downloading from an ordinary website.
What is a cloud torrent client?

A cloud torrent client is a torrent program that runs on remote servers instead of your computer. You hand it a magnet link or .torrent file, it joins the swarm and downloads the content, then serves the files back to you over HTTP — so to your device and your network, torrenting looks like ordinary web traffic.

Webtor is a cloud torrent client wrapped in a player: it downloads in the cloud and streams video on the fly, converts audio, loads subtitles and hands out direct download links. Torrents you add are saved to a personal library, and paid plans add long-term Vault storage, S3 and WebDAV access to mount the library as a drive, and a REST API to script all of it.

tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.benefits.i: Your device never joins the swarm, and other peers never see your IP address

tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.devices.su: Whatever the cloud client downloads lands in your library — and the library follows you around.
tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.devices.it: Watch in the browser on desktop, phone or tablet, or on a TV through the Stremio addon
Mount the library as a network drive over WebDAV or S3 and browse it like local folders
Automate it with the REST API: add torrents, list files and get stream links from your own code
Pledge favourites to the Vault to keep them available long-term
tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.safety.tit: Is a cloud torrent client safe?
tool.cloudTorrentClient.about.safety.tex: Safer than torrenting locally: nothing gets installed, other peers see Webtor's servers instead of your IP address, and everything reaches you over HTTPS. Webtor only processes torrents you add yourself — it is a player and downloader for your own content, not a content catalog.
